title: Not exactly a mall world, but near death experience room.
content: This happened like a few years ago now, I’d say around three. It was a cloudy day, and I woke up not feeling rested enough. I moved to my parents’ room because it was darker (7th grade or so) and I remember the room feeling very cold. I lay down and soon after I fall asleep. I have this dream that keeps on changing, and at one point I was playing a video game, and I was in the middle of either killing another player or getting killed. We were sword battling, and either as soon as they or I died (can’t remember for the life of me), I was immediately transported into this weird space/room. The place: It was a pitch black void that had a gradient to full white near the top. In this space I was standing in front of a cutout of a house, just without a roof- but it’s hard to describe it. The wall that I was standing in front of had a space for a door, but there was no door, simply a cutout of the door. There was a little block of the building left on top of this, so it was kind of like a frame. On both sides on this “door”, there were also cutouts of windows, like a child’s drawing of a house. I cant remember how the house looked from other angles, but I have a drawing somewhere I can dig up for the exact image of it. The thing that I do remember tho, was that there was no roof. This whole house was in an illuminated white, like the sky. In this exact moment that I was standing in front of this place, I became lucid; completely aware that I was in a dream. I think this was the first time ever that I can remember being lucid. As I’m standing there, I get an intense urge to fly, and I do. I start flying through the door, and for some reason I’m being pulled to the “sky”. While flying halfway through the door, I get cocky and decide I want to go faster. Instead of increasing my speed, I send myself vertically up, and smash into the door frame. I remember feeling the impact, and for a few moments there was a struggle, and then I wake up. As I wake up, I’m jolted and still struggle for a few moments, before stopping moving completely and trying to realize what happened. During this time tho, I stay still for too long and enter sleep paralysis. I remember having to fight to be in control of my body, feeling out of place. And I felt the rooms changing from what I saw. Eventually I break free, and realize that I might’ve died. TLDR; I escaped death in a dream by being an idiot lol. I also have dreams in places that I’ve never been in, but I always end up going to. Like seeing where ill go next. It freaks people out and they rarely believe me when i tell them i’ve been here before in a dream. I really wanted to share to this sub because its so fascinating to me. Has anyone had anything similar happen?
